title: Bach opening: SID hybrid
author: Original SID arrangement

articulationChanges.basis: SID-Wizard 1.97 player.asm STRTSND/SETWFR1 and tempo-1 FASTSPEEDBIND
articulationChanges.effect: First frame initializes only frequency high byte and the chosen frame1 waveform; full frequency and table body follow on the next tick. Tempo 1 bypasses hard restart; adjacent notes without a gate-off cell do not retrigger the envelope.

endPolicy: stop with gates closed and main volume zero
